title: Mixer
text: Model mixer in RF systems, {Source of conversion gain} sets Source parameter of conversion; {Available power gain} sets the linear gain of mixer, {Open circuit voltage gain}, {Polynomial coefficients} sets the order of polynomial, {Input impedance (Ohm)} sets the input impedance of mixer, {Output impedance (Ohm)} sets the output impedance of mixer, {LO impedance (Ohm)} sets the impedance at LO port, {Noise figure (dB)} sets the single-sideband IEEE noise figure of mixer, {Ground and hide negative terminals} sets the ground RF circuit terminals, {Nonlinear polynomial type} sets the polynomial nonlinearity Even, {Intercept points convention}, {IP2} sets the second-order intercept point, {IP3} sets the third-order intercept point, {1-dB gain compression power}, {Output saturation power} and {Gain compression at saturation}. Values come from the instance.

params.values: Source parameter of conversion gain Available power gain (default) | Open circuit voltage gain | Polynomial coefficients
